question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it. 

 
 

 
 
9

 
 12
 3
 
 

 12
 14
 17
 
 

 ?
 50
 26
solution:
The logic follows here is :- Going column wise.

(1st number x 3) + 2nd number = 3rd number

So,

 
• 2nd column :(3)3" role="presentation" style="display: inline; position: relative;" tabindex="0">)

⇒(12 x 3) + 14 

⇒36 + 14

⇒50 = 50 (LHS = RHS)

 
• 3rd column :

⇒(3 x 3) + 17 

⇒9 + 17

Similarly,

 
• 1st column :

⇒(9 x 3) + 12 = ?
